jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description:
TalentHunter LTD | Full time | EUR 50,000

Build and maintain user-facing product features, working with design and backend colleagues. Bring strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript skills, experience with a frontend framework such as React, and an understanding of responsive interfaces, accessibility and cross-browser behaviour. Maintain readable code and use Git collaboratively. The public advert requires the legal right to work in Ireland.

Assessment demonstration: this is a summary of a public listing reviewed on 14 September 2026. Applications here are fictional and remain inside Uzair's separate assessment project.
Source: https://www.talenthunter.me/job-detail-one/a2eaa00f-51cc-40b5-b226-6cc8d35dcf43

jobs.title: QA Tester
jobs.description:
TalentHunter LTD | Full time | EUR 45,000

Translate requirements into clear test cases; run functional, regression, smoke and exploratory checks; report reproducible defects and verify fixes. Work with developers and product colleagues, maintain test evidence and improve coverage. The advert asks for at least one year of QA or related experience, web-testing knowledge, clear communication and familiarity with defect tools and Agile delivery. SQL, API testing and automation are advantages. Its location field says Remote, while the description/benefits also mention Dublin and hybrid work; confirm arrangements with the employer.

Assessment demonstration: a summary of the public listing reviewed on 14 September 2026. No real recruitment applications are submitted by this app.
Source: https://www.talenthunter.me/job-detail-one/638dd904-8f56-43b6-bb83-7f1d89c5cc23

jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description:
IBAT Dublin | Full time | EUR 55,000-60,000

Support strategic and operational HR, partnering with managers on employee relations, policies, recruitment, development and workforce planning. The advert seeks five years of HR generalist or senior-adviser experience, relevant degree-level study, CIPD Associate or equivalent, practical Irish employment-law knowledge and confident stakeholder coaching. The hybrid arrangement requires at least three campus days weekly and travel between Dublin campuses when needed.

Assessment demonstration: a concise summary of IBAT's public vacancy reviewed on 14 September 2026. Fictional candidates are used solely to demonstrate the assessment system. This workspace does not represent an IBAT recruitment team.
Source: https://www.talenthunter.me/job-detail-one/a783a708-63e2-4a9e-9ee4-a61c1d88573a
